name: tradeguard-web
description: TradeGuard web app — React SPA: pair selector, 6 layer toggles, lightweight-charts canvas, verdict panel, alerts feed, stats, settings.

notes.lightweight-charts: Engine output maps directly: sr_zones -> createPriceLine / area series, FVGs -> area series, trendlines -> line series with 2 points, future.entries -> setMarkers. Layer toggles = series.applyOptions({visible}).
notes.live-data: Native browser WebSocket to the FastAPI gateway (no extra lib needed); axios for REST scan/stats/settings calls.
notes.push: Browser notifications via the Push API + service worker; backend uses pywebpush.
notes.claude-code: Versions are caret ranges — run npm install and let the lockfile resolve latest compatible.
